creator: Infinite Arena Studio
inputDescription: A solar eclipse blots out the sun over the whole arena
environmentalInteractions: Removes the arena's daylight tag for 60 seconds: solar recharge stops arena-wide.
Adds darkness: fighters with darkness-triggered weaknesses take amplified damage; shadow-affine kits benefit.
sideEffects: Affects BOTH teams equally — drafting your own solar fighter into your own eclipse is on you.
Daylight-gated contextual abilities are unusable while it lasts.
counterplay: Wait out the 60-second duration — stored charge bridges the gap for disciplined fighters.
It is symmetrical: exploit the darkness harder than your opponent does.
Teams without light-dependency simply ignore it.
visualManifestation: A false moon slides across the sun; the arena falls into deep blue twilight ringed by a corona.
audioManifestation: A hush, then a low wind as the light dies.
provenance: Curated Season 0 template: lighting/solar condition archetype.
